newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi nine-month sales slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi nine-month sales slightly higher.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
NOTE - Sanofi, majority owned by Elf-Aquitaine, said sales were up 1.5 percent at constant structure and 2.9 percent at constant structure and unchanged exchange rates.
It said the growth in pharmaceuticals during the first half had continued on the back of big international products.

It said there was seven percent sales growth in pharmaceuticals in West Europe, 26 percent in East and Central Europe, 17 percent in Asia and eight percent in Latin America while the slowdown in the United States had stabilised.
In perfumes and beauty products, sales benefitted in the United States from the launch of Opium for men under the Yves Saint Laurent brand but sales in Europe remained difficult.
Sanofi said the results were in line with its objectives.
